title: Sugar Valley Canoe Trips
specs: Self-guided trips on scenic Sugar Creek with bus transport to start and pick up at end
Family friendly zone with no profanity or rude behavior allowed
Weight limit for tandem kayak: 500 lbs
At least one person at cabin or campsite must be 18 years old; no one under 16 without adult over 21
Children under 6 must have one adult per child; older age restrictions apply at high creek levels
Pregnant women require written doctor's consent
10% group discount for 10 or more canoes reserved in advance

blurb: Guests rent canoes, kayaks, or tubes and are bussed to their starting location for self-guided trips on Sugar Creek. They carry their equipment at the end of the trip to the loading zone. Cabins and tent sites are available for overnight stays with specific rules and capacity limits.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made 2 weeks prior for trips; 1 month prior for Covered Bridge Festival reservations · $20 minimum cancellation fee for cabins; late cancellations (less than 2 weeks) no refund · Cancellations called in 5 days before date for deposit return for trips · Trips run rain or shine; cancellations only for high water · Additional deposit $20 minimum or $5 per canoe/kayak required · Additional $50 deposit or credit card held at office if taking alcohol on trips · No tolerance policy for alcohol; public intoxication results in loss of deposit and privileges · Check-in noon to 9 PM; no late check-ins allowed · Sugar Valley Canoe Rentals office
